prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic playful morning bed selfie of an approved adult woman.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with light golden-blonde tousled hair and curtain bangs, warm brown eyes, natural rosy skin, bright toothy smile, and playful wink, wearing an opaque pale-cream button-down shirt fully secured over opaque lounge bottoms.
prompt.composition_elements: High-angle 24–28mm selfie while seated comfortably on a plush white bed, one arm holding camera and one resting on mattress, blurred wooden nightstand, neutral walls, lamp and personal items.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm bright morning sunlight from upper left creates gentle rim lighting and soft face shadows, spontaneous goofy woke-up-like mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-photorealistic 8K-style raw smartphone image, sharp face, realistic linen and skin, shallow background depth and natural grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An ultra-photorealistic playful morning selfie of an approved adult woman with light golden-blonde tousled hair, curtain bangs, warm brown eyes, natural rosy skin, and a bright toothy smile with one eye winking. She wears an opaque pale-cream button-down shirt fully secured over opaque lounge bottoms, seated comfortably on a plush white bed. One arm holds the camera and the other rests on the mattress. A blurred wooden nightstand, neutral beige walls, lamp, and personal items sit behind her. Warm morning sun from the upper left creates gentle hair rim light and soft face shadows. Use 24–28mm high-angle smartphone perspective, realistic fabric and skin, shallow background depth, raw 8K-style detail, and carefree energy.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, translucent shirt, open buttons, exposed chest, tongue out, sexualized expression, prone sexual pose, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, hair, wink, bed, bedroom, morning light, and cream palette; keep shirt opaque and secured, with no typography or logos.
